Tier2 link conversion with accessible names enabled

```java title="Java"
import io.xberg.htmltomarkdown.*;

public final class Example {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        var optionsJson = "{\"inline_data_media\":\"AltTextOnly\",\"tier_strategy\":\"Tier2\"}";
        var options = JsonUtil.fromJson(optionsJson, ConversionOptions.class);
        var result = HtmlToMarkdownRs.convertWithAccessibleNames("<p>see <a href=\"https://example.com/x\">GitHub<svg aria-label=\"(opens in new tab)\"><use href=\"#ext\"></use></svg></a> now</p>", true, options);
        System.out.println(result.content());
    }
}
```
